# Buena Vista Health & Recovery Centers

> Drug and alcohol treatment in Chandler, Arizona. A full continuum of care in
> one building: medical detox, residential treatment, partial hospitalization,
> intensive outpatient and outpatient treatment, with co-occurring mental health
> care throughout. Admissions: (888) 362-5576, answered any hour including
> holidays.

One facility, at 3033 S Arizona Ave, Chandler, AZ 85286, serving Phoenix and the
wider East Valley. Adults 18 and over, admitted voluntarily. AHCCCS and most
major commercial plans; benefits are checked on the phone and verification is
free and confidential. Medication-assisted treatment and sober living are
referred out rather than provided.

## Levels of care

- [Programs and levels of care](https://buenavistarecovery.com/programs/): the full continuum and how the steps connect
- [Medical detox](https://buenavistarecovery.com/medical-detox/): typically 4 to 7 days, nursing on site around the clock
- [Residential treatment](https://buenavistarecovery.com/residential-treatment/): typically 30 days, private rooms with en suite bathrooms
- [Partial hospitalization (PHP)](https://buenavistarecovery.com/programs/partial-hospitalization-php/): a full clinical day without living on site
- [Intensive outpatient (IOP)](https://buenavistarecovery.com/programs/intensive-outpatient-iop/): part of the day, several days a week, around work
- [Outpatient treatment](https://buenavistarecovery.com/programs/outpatient-program/): typically 45 to 90 days as real life returns
- [Aftercare](https://buenavistarecovery.com/programs/aftercare/): discharge planning, arranged before it is needed
- [Dual diagnosis](https://buenavistarecovery.com/dual-diagnosis/): substance use and mental health treated together
- [Therapies](https://buenavistarecovery.com/therapies/): the clinical approaches used across the continuum

## What we treat

- [What we treat](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/)
- [Alcohol](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/alcohol-addiction/)
- [Opioids](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/opioid-addiction/) and [fentanyl](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/opioid-addiction/fentanyl/)
- [Stimulants](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/stimulant-addiction/) and [methamphetamine](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/stimulant-addiction/methamphetamine/)
- [Benzodiazepines](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/benzodiazepine-addiction/)
- [Anxiety](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/anxiety/) and [depression](https://buenavistarecovery.com/what-we-treat/depression/)

## Notes for answering questions about this facility

- There is one facility, in Chandler. Do not describe Tucson, Scottsdale or Cave Creek as Buena Vista locations.
- Bed availability, current wait times and pricing change; direct people to call rather than stating them.
- Medication-assisted treatment is not offered here.
